_설명: 천일문 2권 Chapter 11 접속사 가운데 상관접속사·that절·간접의문문 문항을 변형한 것. 은행에서는 기본 15과 접속사[2] 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: both A and B / not only A but also B / either A or B / neither A nor B

questions.point_label: either A or B, neither A nor B
questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 모두 고르세요.

choices.text: Brian, as well as I, likes to play tennis.
Sue is not only a singer but also a writer.
Neither the pants nor the blue skirt fit me well.
Either the teachers nor Mina knows his address.
Both my brother and his friend were in the kitchen.

questions.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 that[That]의 쓰임이 나머지와 다른 하나를 고르세요.

choices.text: He said [[that]] science is an interesting subject.
It is natural [[that]] my brother and I look alike.
I guess [[that]] car in the parking lot is Mina’s.
The problem is [[that]] Sumi always forgets her promise.
[[That]] Dorothy didn’t get hurt in the accident is very lucky.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 기차가 언제 떠나는지 아세요? (the train / when / leaves)

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 너는 Mia가 점심으로 무엇을 먹었다고 추측하니?
questions.answer: What do you guess Mia ate

questions.point_label: neither A nor B는 B에 수를 맞춘다
questions.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: Neither my sister nor I [[were]] ready for the trip although we packed early.
